card.name: Linking words in all-caps emergency treatment lists
card.fires_on: The words AND, INCLUDING, or a comma inside an all-caps warning about emergency treatment of hypersensitivity reactions. It fires where the list of measures (oxygen, steroids, antihistamines, airway management) continues.

modes.label: AND or comma in the list
modes.description: The joining word or comma sits between items in the capitalized list of emergency treatments.
modes.example: OXYGEN, INTRAVENOUS STEROIDS<< AND>> AIRWAY MANAGEMENT, INCLUDING INTUBATION

modes.label: INCLUDING after emergency measures
modes.description: The word INCLUDING introduces the list of emergency measures after epinephrine.
modes.example: ACUTE HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS MAY REQUIRE TREATMENT WITH EPINEPHRINE AND OTHER EMERGENCY MEASURES,<< INCLUDING>> OXYGEN, INTRAVEN

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward starting the next capitalized word, such as the first letters of an all-caps term.
card.plain: It lights up on the joining words in the shouted-capitals list of emergency steps for severe allergic reactions.
